creative_direction: Paint Doraemon in a simple loose pale-blue bedtime jacket, with his familiar red nose, whiskers, and bell still visible. His round hands rest together beneath the chin, and his mouth forms a contented smile. Preserve the white eye shapes and keep the iris patterns small. Use thin ink contours with quiet evening washes, leaving space around the moon and rounded head. Use varied ink line weight, light pigment washes, and generous negative space. Use muted rose-violet irises with fine concentric rings, visible pupils, and clear highlights. Place a pale moon disc behind the character; keep the mood gentle and unthreatening. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
